title: Microsoft AI Readiness Assessment
quote: Business Strategy, AI Governance & Security, Data Foundations, AI Strategy & Experience, Organization & Culture, Infrastructure for AI, and Model Management.
scope: Microsoft assessment dimensions illustrate multidimensional readiness, not a universal maturity score or organizational approval.

title: UK Government Data Quality Framework guidance
quote: responsibility for maintaining metadata records for data sets.
scope: UK public-sector guidance used as an explicitly attributed data management reference; does not prescribe all organizational policies.

title: AWS Well-Architected pillars
quote: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability
scope: AWS architecture reference supports evaluating multiple operating requirements, rather than hardware rankings alone; case details remain exercise assumptions.

title: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.3 / 2.5
quote: AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured qualitatively or quantitatively and demonstrated for conditions similar to deployment setting(s).
scope: Deployment-context evaluation; transfer outside tested conditions still requires evidence.

title: NIST AI RMF MANAGE 2.4
quote: Mechanisms are in place and applied, and responsibilities are assigned and understood, to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.
scope: Defines governance mechanisms and assigned responsibilities; exact stopping powers in activities are explicitly set by the exercise.

title: Microsoft RACI role definitions
quote: Responsible (R): The person who performs the task. b. Accountable (A): The person ultimately answerable for the task's completion.
scope: RACI distinction is methodological; named exercise roles are not universally mandated job titles.

title: NIST AI 600-1 MAP 4.1 intellectual property controls
quote: Implement processes for responding to potential intellectual property infringement claims or other rights.
scope: Intellectual property review is a separate risk task from harmful-content review; no jurisdiction-specific permission determination is made by the game.

title: Microsoft AI Center of Excellence responsibilities
quote: Let frontline teams own delivery and implementation while forums provide policy and oversight.
scope: This is the Microsoft advisory CoE operating model: frontline delivery and implementation remain separate from policy and oversight; it is illustrative rather than a universal mandatory org chart.

title: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5
quote: Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.
scope: Explicitly bound generalization to the tested conditions rather than treating pilot success as transfer proof.

title: UK data quality: communicating fitness for user needs
quote: whether the data meets their needs.
scope: Section Communicating data quality to users connects quality and context to appropriate use; the quoted fragment locates that passage rather than defining a universal quality score.

title: UK data maturity models and quality: continuous capability assessment
quote: regular maturity assessments can be made
scope: The source concerns data capability maturity and continuous improvement. The teaching transfers the assessment method to AI capability planning as an explicit analogy, not a universal AI certification or mandated level system.
